properties.rule: doc/dom.md: 'The parsed document resulting from parser.parse depends on the parser instance... you must have at most one parsed document in play per parser instance.' Every parse, parse_many or allocate on the parser invalidates elements from the previous document; parse_many documents are replaced when the stream advances.
properties.formula: (!e_use W e_root) & G(e_gone -> X(!e_use W e_root))

e_root.meaning: a parse (or a stream step) produced a root element

e_gone.meaning: the parser is reused or the stream moves to the next document

e_use.meaning: an element routine is about to be called

examples.reason: a failed lookup leaves the current element usable
a failed reparse still destroyed the previous document

properties.rule: dom::array and its iterators are views into the parser's document (doc/dom.md); they exist after element::get_array succeeds and die with the document.
properties.formula: (!a_use W a_new) & G(e_gone -> X(!a_use W a_new))

a_use.meaning: an array view routine is about to be called

properties.rule: dom::object and its iterators are views into the parser's document; they exist after element::get_object succeeds and die with the document.
properties.formula: (!o_use W o_new) & G(e_gone -> X(!o_use W o_new))

o_use.meaning: an object view routine is about to be called

properties.rule: doc/parse_many.md: the document_stream iterates documents inside the parser; it exists after parse_many succeeds and is invalidated by any other use of the parser.
properties.formula: (!s_use W s_new) & G(s_gone -> X(!s_use W s_new))

s_use.meaning: a stream iterator routine is about to be called

properties.rule: doc/basics.md: 'A parser instance can only be used for one document at a time'; a new iterate/iterate_many invalidates the previous document. After a fatal error (INCOMPLETE_ARRAY_OR_OBJECT, TAPE_ERROR) 'the document instance cannot be used' and is_alive() is false.
properties.formula: (!d_use W d_new) & G(d_gone -> X(!d_use W d_new))

d_gone.meaning: the parser is reused or the document died

d_use.meaning: a document routine is about to be called

properties.rule: doc/basics.md rules 2-3: the document is an iterator; its value is consumed once, and reading it again requires rewind() ('It allows you to restart processing from the beginning'). at_pointer rewinds itself first, so it is exempt, but it leaves the document positioned after the pointed value.

consume_again.meaning: a non-rewinding read of the document

examples.reason: rewind between reads; at_pointer rewinds itself

properties.rule: doc/basics.md rule 3: 'Values can only be consumed once'. rewind() and at_pointer 'invalidate all values, objects and arrays', as does a new document, a fatal error, or advancing the iterator that produced the value. type() only peeks.
properties.formula: (!v_use W v_new) & G(v_gone -> X(!v_use W v_new))

v_gone.meaning: the value was consumed or invalidated

v_use.meaning: a value routine is about to be called

properties.rule: ondemand::array iterators exist after get_array succeeds (document or value) and are invalidated by rewind/at_pointer, a new document, or a fatal error. operator* 'MUST ONLY BE CALLED ONCE PER ITERATION' (singleheader/simdjson.h:87207, 90950).
properties.formula: (!a_use W a_new) & G(a_gone -> X(!a_use W a_new)) & G(deref -> X(!deref W step))

a_use.meaning: an array iterator routine is about to be called

deref.meaning: the current element is read ('MUST ONLY BE CALLED ONCE PER ITERATION')

step.meaning: the iterator moves on, or a new container starts

properties.rule: ondemand::object iterators and find_field exist after get_object succeeds and are invalidated by rewind/at_pointer, a new document, or a fatal error. operator* 'MUST ONLY BE CALLED ONCE PER ITERATION' (singleheader/simdjson.h:87207, 90950).
properties.formula: (!o_use W o_new) & G(o_gone -> X(!o_use W o_new)) & G(deref -> X(!deref W step))

o_use.meaning: an object routine is about to be called

deref.meaning: the current element is read ('MUST ONLY BE CALLED ONCE PER ITERATION')

step.meaning: the iterator moves on, or a new container starts

properties.rule: doc/iterate_many.md: the document_stream belongs to the parser; documents from it are valid until the iterator advances; any other use of the parser invalidates it.
properties.formula: (!s_use W s_new) & G(s_gone -> X(!s_use W s_new)) & (!r_use W r_new) & G(r_gone -> X(!r_use W r_new))

s_use.meaning: a stream iterator routine is about to be called

r_gone.meaning: the stream advanced or the parser was reused

r_use.meaning: a document_reference routine is about to be called

properties.rule: doc/basics.md rule 3 ('Values can only be consumed once') applied to the simdjson_result<value> of a lookup (find_field_unordered / operator[] / at_path, singleheader/simdjson.h:84990-85218, chained as in doc/basics.md 'doc["a"]["b"]'): reading it, chaining a further lookup, or taking its value out consumes it; rewind(), at_pointer/at_path on the document, a new document, a fatal error and advancing the stream invalidate it. type() and the is_* / count_* / location checks only peek.
properties.formula: (!r_use W r_new) & G(r_gone -> X(!r_use W r_new))

r_new.meaning: a lookup produced a successful simdjson_result<value>

r_gone.meaning: the result is consumed or its document position is gone

r_use.meaning: a simdjson_result<value> routine is about to be called

properties.rule: doc/iterate_many.md + doc/basics.md rules 2-3: a stream document reached through document_reference (singleheader/simdjson.h:88132-88275, every routine forwards to the stream's document) is read once like a document; reading it again needs rewind() (singleheader/simdjson.h:88132) or the next document (iterator ++). at_path / for_each_at_path_with_wildcard rewind first; count_elements / count_fields rewind on success (singleheader/simdjson.h:93314).

consume_again.meaning: a read that needs an unread document

examples.reason: dereferencing again yields the same, already read document

properties.rule: singleheader/simdjson.h:87262-87276: simdjson_result<array_iterator> from begin() of a document, value or result is iterated like the range-for of doc/basics.md; operator* 'MUST ONLY BE CALLED ONCE PER ITERATION' (singleheader/simdjson.h:87271). The iterator dies with its document position: rewind / at_pointer / at_path, a new document, a fatal error, the stream advancing, or advancing the iterator of an enclosing array or object.
properties.formula: (!i_use W i_new) & G(i_gone -> X(!i_use W i_new)) & G(deref -> X(!deref W step))

i_use.meaning: an iterator result routine is about to be called

step.meaning: the iterator moves to a new element

properties.rule: singleheader/simdjson.h:88860: unescaped_key() 'consumes the key: once you have called unescaped_key(), you cannot call it again nor can you call key()'. key_raw_json_token() and escaped_key() may be called repeatedly. A new field comes from the object iterator's operator*.
properties.formula: (!k_use W k_new) & G(k_gone -> X(!k_use W k_new))

k_use.meaning: a key routine that needs an unconsumed key

properties.rule: A raw_json_string is 'A pointer to the raw JSON for the given string' (singleheader/simdjson.h:84784): it points into the input of the iterated document, which the next iterate / iterate_many replaces (and parser move-assignment orphans). The == / != comparisons (singleheader/simdjson.h:86366-86372) need a live raw_json_string.
properties.formula: (!s_use W s_new) & G(s_gone -> X(!s_use W s_new))

s_use.meaning: a comparison is about to read it
